description: Add a line item to an existing order by its externalId. Recomputes the order total. Only allowed while the order is pending or confirmed; on any other status (processing and later, cancelled, refunded) it fails with 409 CONFLICT "Order lines can only be changed while the order is pending or confirmed". Use list_orders or create_order for the order externalId, and search_products to quote a real product. The result echoes the operating workspace.

discount.description: Percentage discount on this line (0-100). Default 0.

externalId.description: The order externalId returned by list_orders or create_order.

productName.description: Line item name, snapshotted onto the order. Use search_products to quote a real catalog product's name. Required.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the order currency, as a decimal (e.g. 199.99). Snapshotted onto the line.

name: add_order_item
title: Add order item
